name: Kupipi
summary: A dedicated healer whose priorities and positioning adapt to her selected support job.
overview: Kupipi supports the party with healing, status recovery, and defensive magic. Her custom support job changes healing thresholds, spell options, and frontline positioning.

behaviors.title: Emergency Healing
behaviors.condition: A party member falls below the emergency HP threshold for the selected support job.
behaviors.action: Prioritize emergency healing for the most critically injured eligible ally.

behaviors.title: Routine Healing
behaviors.condition: An eligible party member falls below the routine HP threshold.
behaviors.action: Use routine cures; second-highest healing target selection is under development.

behaviors.title: Positioning
behaviors.condition: Support job changes between backline and frontline profiles.
behaviors.action: Stay back as WHM/RDM; move forward as WAR/NIN.

behaviors.title: Utsusemi
behaviors.action: Enable Utsusemi spells; exact shadow recast decisions are still being refined.

behaviors.title: Weapon Skills
behaviors.condition: Sufficient TP and a valid combat target.
behaviors.action: Use configured weapon skill selection when supported.

equipment: Default Trust equipment — details to be added
notes: Behavior details reflect Cleopatra XI design and testing; availability is not a guarantee of live implementation.

name: Ulmia
summary: A song-focused companion designed to reposition for melee and mage songs.
overview: Ulmia is being designed to move toward melee allies to apply frontline songs, then return to the backline for mage songs.

behaviors.title: Melee Song Positioning
behaviors.action: Approach melee allies to sing, then return to a safer position.

behaviors.title: Mage Song Positioning
behaviors.action: Return to the backline and apply mage-oriented songs.

behaviors.title: Song Refresh
behaviors.condition: Two melee songs are active or approaching expiration.
behaviors.action: Evaluate whether to refresh songs; final timing not yet confirmed.

spells: Bard songs — detailed list to be added
notes: Detailed gambit order is not yet finalized.
